extra.message: User-controlled input from the 'name' query parameter is interpolated into an HTML string via f-string and then passed to jinja2.Template().render(). This enables server-side template injection (SSTI), allowing execution of arbitrary Jinja2 expressions and potential remote code execution.

User input from the 'name' query parameter and external HTTP response 'public_ip' are directly interpolated into an HTML f-string without escaping or sanitization. The resulting string is returned as HTMLResponse, allowing reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
Hardcoded sensitive value 'SUPER_SECRET_NAME' found in source code. This should be loaded from environment variables instead of being embedded in the application code.
Hardcoded sensitive token 'SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN' found in source code. This should be loaded from environment variables instead of being embedded in the application code.
